entries.observation: The predecessor initially named six roles without six reproducible source identities.
entries.cause: Comparator count and semantic role were not sufficient implementation identities.
entries.repair: All six roles now have paper-linked repository revisions, licence bytes and entrypoints.
entries.residual: Identity does not bind execution, resource parity, rights, adapters or custody.
entries.next_discriminator: Freeze a complete matched execution manifest for every retained identity without replacing arms using outcomes.

entries.observation: Each arm has a same-visible-symptom pair compatible with at least two minimal P5 classes.
entries.cause: Native patches, progress states, ranks, scores, diagnostic statuses and typed artifacts expose less information than the eight-class target.
entries.repair: The fibre factorisation theorem and six prospective adversarial fixtures formalize the interface limit.
entries.residual: Zero raw native symptom fibres license a singleton P5 class.
entries.next_discriminator: Add a host-validated input-native class certificate and complete single-class write-set proof without exposing outcomes.

entries.observation: Patch produced plus process success is compatible with execution, evaluator and other scientific repair fronts.
entries.cause: A generic repository patch is not a revision-responsibility certificate.
entries.repair: SWE-agent conditionally supports all seven classes only with an exclusive-front action manifest, host certificate and invariance receipt.
entries.residual: No released or hashed P5 adapter, model/config envelope or protected scorer exists.
entries.next_discriminator: Implement and hash the certificate/front registry, isolated write surface and prediction manifest on synthetic fixtures.

entries.observation: Replay improvement, CONVERGED, NEED_MORE_WORK, fundamental-limit and deployment states do not identify a P5 class.
entries.cause: Self-evolution progress and host promotion are distinct from scientific revision responsibility.
entries.repair: Only certified single-front successor mutations in four agent/scaffold classes may project to a singleton.
entries.residual: Evidence, measurement and evaluator classes are unsupported; provider/model/session rights and matched budgets remain open.
entries.next_discriminator: Disable promotion, replace recent-session intake with the frozen packet and bind the isolated no-outcome successor adapter.

entries.observation: Archive-best selection is compatible with model expansion or mere execution repair and can be affected by outcome-aware parent choice.
entries.cause: Archive rank and selected child mutation are different fibres; the pinned CLI also retains a choice defect.
entries.repair: Only the complete selected child mutation plus an exclusive-front certificate may project to one of four supported classes.
entries.residual: Evidence, measurement and evaluator are unsupported; archive policy, budgets, provider rights and defect disposition remain unfrozen.
entries.next_discriminator: Freeze public-development evolution, the final archive node and a declared native-versus-repaired CLI identity before protected use.

entries.observation: An open issue profile plus a compiling patch is compatible with within-class model or execution repair.
entries.cause: Free-text failure modes and profile lifecycle states do not uniquely denote revision classes; source write-surface descriptions conflict.
entries.repair: Require a schema-valid typed plan and complete mutation to agree on one of four supported agent/scaffold classes.
entries.residual: CC BY-NC-SA restrictions, third-party content rights, exact surface, model/provider and aggregate budgets remain unresolved.
entries.next_discriminator: Obtain lawful-use disposition and freeze one exact allow-list plus a deterministic plan/write-set validator.

entries.observation: The native DRAWBACK status is compatible with evidence repair and evaluator repair.
entries.cause: A metric diagnosis reports a symptom, not the minimal responsibility class; official evolution repeatedly observes eval_locked.
entries.repair: Only EVALUATOR_REPAIR is conditionally supported, requiring an input-native evaluator-defect certificate, unchanged solver bytes, evaluator-only mutation and development validity.
entries.residual: CLEAN, DRAWBACK and ABSTAIN alone remain UNRESOLVED; a development surrogate and once-only external protected score are not bound.
entries.next_discriminator: Freeze solver bytes and a development-only locked surrogate, then seal the final metric before one-shot external protected scoring.

entries.observation: An open need with a valid typed artifact is compatible with evidence or measurement repair.
entries.cause: Artifact lineage, drafts, open needs and status mutations are not minimal revision decisions.
entries.repair: None; the terminal-preserving native adapter supports no singleton class.
entries.residual: Every native ScienceClaw class projection remains UNRESOLVED; external scoring cannot manufacture a candidate decision.
entries.next_discriminator: A separately specified, prospectively frozen ScienceClaw revision-proposal module would be a material method change and needs its own identity.

entries.observation: Native defaults are partially bound, but no arm has a complete content-addressed matched P5 execution manifest.
entries.cause: Repository identity does not determine models, services, containers, whole-run budgets, retries, network, rights or scorer custody.
entries.repair: A field-level six-arm resource/config ledger now distinguishes bound metadata, freezable values and noncompensatory blockers.
entries.residual: Zero of six arms are confirmatory-ready.
entries.next_discriminator: Choose and hash every per-arm runtime/resource/service manifest and one common matched-exposure/scorer manifest.

entries.observation: The deterministic adapter passed 90/90 synthetic contract cases, with 70 UNRESOLVED and 20 certified singleton action types.
entries.cause: Conformance can be mistaken for correct revision, preservation, fresh transfer or superiority.
entries.repair: The receipt explicitly records zero native examples, zero outcomes and zero performance authority.
entries.residual: H1-H4, protected freshness, harm, performance and superiority remain CANNOT_CHECK.
entries.next_discriminator: After every precondition freezes, run all six arms under external custody on the protected source-disjoint panel.

current_frontier: The next scientific question is whether the information added by a lawful input-native certificate and exclusive-front action manifest is sufficient to produce correct minimal revisions under matched external evaluation; raw native status vocabularies are formally insufficient.
